question: Should this credential-boundary change require a redacted exact-head live assist publication and repeated-request demonstration before merge?
rationale: Source inspection and tests cannot establish the effective hosted token scopes, cross-job artifact transfer, or resulting live GitHub comment behavior.

options.title: Require live workflow proof
options.body: Block merge until redacted exact-head generator and publisher output, the resulting comment, and a repeated request demonstrate the intended boundary and idempotency.

options.title: Accept hosted-runtime uncertainty
options.body: Merge after source review while explicitly accepting the unobserved GitHub Actions credential, artifact-transfer, and retry behavior.

recommendation.title: Require live workflow proof
recommendation.body: Block merge until redacted exact-head generator and publisher output, the resulting comment, and a repeated request demonstrate the intended boundary and idempotency.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and recently maintained the assist workflow and owns this privilege-boundary change.
